item.title: Australia: Hypersensitive Chip Offers Non-Invasive Glioblastoma Insights
item.description: UQ researchers developed a hypersensitive diagnostic chip that monitors glioblastoma treatment response through blood samples, reducing reliance on invasive brain procedures.

item.title: The Philippines: Digital Innovation in Infrastructure, Energy, Tourism
item.description: The Philippine government is leveraging digital innovation and strategic partnerships to modernise infrastructure, energy and tourism, improve services and drive inclusive economic growth nationwide.

item.title: Hong Kong: CityUHK Unveils Interpretable AI Asset Pricing Model
item.description: CityUHK researchers developed an interpretable machine learning model that improves asset pricing and portfolio construction by analysing complex financial data.

item.title: Vietnam: E-commerce, Digital Innovation Driving Inclusive Growth
item.description: Vietnam’s e-commerce sector is driving the nation’s digital transformation, combining innovation, regulatory reforms and technology adoption to modernise commerce and strengthen competitiveness.

item.title: Singapore: National Space Agency to Drive Innovation and Industry Growth
item.description: The National Space Agency aims to strengthen space capabilities, grow industry, expand partnerships and develop regulations supporting innovation, safety and sustainability.

item.title: Malaysia: Technology, Advanced Manufacturing Propel Export Growth
item.description: Broader integration of tech-driven global supply chains and the growing role of advanced manufacturing in its export economy have boosted Malaysia’s external trade performance in 2025.

item.title: The Philippines: Digitalisation Drives MSME Innovation and Growth
item.description: The DTI is actively helping MSMEs in Siquijor and Ifugao expand markets, embrace digitalisation, adopt modern tools and access vital resources, training programmes and support through digital hubs.

item.title: Australia: Extended Reality Transforms CSI Education
item.description: Murdoch University is using extended reality technology to deliver immersive, accessible crime scene investigation training for forensic science students and professionals to operate in an increasingly tech-savvy world.

item.title: Indonesia, Malaysia to Advance Next-Gen Semiconductors
item.description: Indonesia is strengthening semiconductor capabilities through a Malaysia partnership and a focus on chip design, talent development and domestic manufacturing to reduce import dependence and boost industry resilience.

item.title: Singapore: Enhancing CPF Account Security Amid Rising Digital Fraud
item.description: Singapore enhances personal and regional digital security with CPF Trusted Contact notifications, Safety Switch measures and ASEAN initiatives to combat scams and strengthen cybersecurity resilience.
